title: Verify the released-control Clifford ceiling and conditional cost gate (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Preserve a source-bound obstruction for Dillon's released two-FULL/one-query operator-intersection target. For fixed finite columnwise monomial-Clifford plus scalar-owner programs on the actual 17 axes, the four free-membership conditions force `t0_f = 0` at every sufficiently large width. The all-width invertible contract therefore cannot hold in this declared class. The direct scalar-owner argument is retained separately. This does not classify every physically FREE program or exclude exceptional small widths.

The corrected proof uses `Ht = D3 H0 D3^-1`, permits the central direction to shift by a W vector, and preserves the rejected `Ht = H0` inference as a warning. Separate exact arithmetic assumes the unrealized complete invoice `T = 224 H17 + 816 H9`, `P = 4608 H1 + 838 H2 + 1020 H3 + 254 H4 + 136 H5`. On `C ∈ [.0030217758,.00339999]`, 44 additional H1 is maximal for uniform strict raw positivity; 45 fails at the upper endpoint. Finite work, endpoint completion, compiler reserves and outer transfer remain unpriced. No caller or κ improvement is claimed.

A distinct independently reviewed appendix closes the scalar-owner commuting-X paid-shear subclass: for `S_k = I + u_k v_k^T tensor H_k`, the endpoint's identity coefficient forces `m >= 112`. The narrower explicit rank-two execution costs `3m H2` and permits at most seven shears under the conditional raw allowance. This is not a universal implementation/query lower bound. Operator-valued gathers, noncommuting alphabets and retained native observations remain outside it. No paid construction or search ran.

## Task and overlap

This answers [released handoff 4930#19143357](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930#discussioncomment-19143357), with the bounded investigation rooted at [4930#19143614](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930#discussioncomment-19143614). Scientific source: `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, `research/coded-native-caller`. Context #5126 head `0e8a13c251a9be1029114cda8b4194f05f3a23ec` is not an executable free alphabet. Publication base: `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`. Task `joint-query-controller`; scope changed from the installed QQ16 matched-protocol question to this exact released decoder/control obligation. The task card permits a scoped obligation of a newer local decoder; no installed QQ16 win is claimed.

This new module preserves reviewed proof, independent review, inventory and the separate budget-author packet unchanged. The separate stopped paid-shear capsule is outside the main FREE theorem. Its exact historical CONTRACT is retained only with its stop proof and independent review. Noncolumnwise/non-Clifford/growing-alphabet controls, changed paid words, extra axes or different targets remain outside the obstruction.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/released-operator-clifford-ceiling/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/released-operator-clifford-ceiling/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/released-operator-clifford-ceiling --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/released-operator-clifford-ceiling
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/released-operator-clifford-ceiling --ref HEAD --check-source-history
```

Direct normal/O and registered runs pass. The hook authenticates 53 immutable evidence files, executes five source/flag and five invoice controls, and reproduces full frozen source/flag and budget receipts byte for byte. The source witness is binary symplectic only. The hook separately authenticates the written paid-shear appendix and checks its explicit 7/8-count price arithmetic; it does not machine-check the coefficient-rank proof. The all-width theorem remains an independently reviewed written proof; no machine-checked phase, native endpoint, compiler or Lean replay is claimed. Private logical-path relocation preserves every receipt field. About 3 seconds per direct run on CPython 3.12, standard library only.

Committed-byte/source ancestry and official export checks pass. Fresh Git-free normal/O replay passes with identical receipts and unchanged exported bytes. HISTORY.md records an initial failed CRLF-normalizing staging attempt; local `.gitattributes` now preserves the original raw source bytes. Hosted [run 39945332159](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39945332159) passes at contribution head `7800589ce99d932bdb063aafca1f501f1a38626d` (tested merge `f94e7d91a29d7080613bb6a0c16e305b87735718`, base `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`): 414 helper tests / 17 platform skips, actual registered normal and optimized replay, and committed-input integrity. Both modes report `PASS_SCOPED_SUPPORT_AND_CONDITIONAL_ARITHMETIC`. This verifies the declared finite hook, not the all-width written theorem, native endpoint, compiler or κ admission.

Contribution head: `7800589ce99d932bdb063aafca1f501f1a38626d`.

Astra proof/source-flag author, independent ceiling reviewer, Chris R/Clear1nsight source-inventory/packaging agent, and separate p19 compiler-contracts budget author are credited. ## Open next questions

Specify one actual paid or non-Clifford program, all four controls/inverses, arbitrary-input ownership/charts and a complete affordable bill. The conditional 44 H1 allowance is not a compiler reserve or free physical implementation. No further Clifford search or prospective paid construction is included in the main result.
